description: AD 774-775 Miyake-class event modelled by stretching Bastille Day 2000 (the cycle-23 max event with the highest training F10.7 we have at 315 SFU) to a 48-h saturated plateau with 2× F10.7. Mekhaldi+2015 estimates 774 AD fluence ≈ 10× August 1972; the prolonged plateau models that integrated dose, not the instantaneous peak (which 3-h indices cannot resolve).
warnings: Ap saturation: rows reach the 400 ceiling; the index does not resolve magnitude beyond that point.
F10.7 = 629 SFU exceeds the predictor's training maximum of 315 SFU; predictions here are extrapolations and must be checked for monotonicity / smoothness only, not accuracy.
